body:
The maintainer hit this on 2026-11-13 (in chat): "The setup things where we carry stock between setups for rest machining is giving a strange error" and "whole idea is that stock IS getting turned between setups."

What he saw (Face2 in Setup2, stock source "what Setup1 leaves behind", Setup2 holding the part turned X -90°):

```
generate failed: could not generate the toolpath: Face2: invalid machining parameters: Face2: this operation reads the stock earlier setups left, and that stock cannot be carried into its setup: carrying the machined stock from setup 'Setup1' into setup 'Setup2': 'Setup2' holds the part turned X -90°, Y 0°, Z 0° from how 'Setup1' holds it, and the stock simulation can carry machined stock only through a flip over X or Y or a quarter turn about Z (turns that keep the tool axis vertical) - any other turn would have to re-sample the stock and lose its detail
```

Priority raised from P8 to P4 (work the maintainer asked for, in his words above): a second setup that stands the part on its side is the ordinary case for carried stock, so the refusal blocks the feature's main use. Until this lands the workaround is to give Setup2 its own stock instead of the carried one.

Two things owed here: the side-on carry itself (a re-sample that never leaves the carried stock smaller than the real one, so rest machining cannot run into uncut material), and a shorter message for whatever turns stay refused.
claimed: Codex (uma) · 2026-11-14T18:16:03Z · branch mkinney:issue/874-side-on-carry · plan: pin the side-on stock refusal and implement conservative carried stock with verified volume and verdicts.

Claim released. I reproduced the side-on refusal but did not complete a safe fix. No production code changed and no PR was opened.

The new test faced_plate_carries_side_on_with_its_volume_and_verdict fails on unchanged upstream/main (4f4edcf35465c3ee83d7d4197685fc0e661e52f1). It fails at the carry-refusal assertion for Setup2 turned X -90 degrees. The volume and verdict assertions have not run.

The held test is uncommitted in .claude/worktrees/issue-874 on branch issue/874-side-on-carry in the local CamcraftCodex checkout. The failure text is saved locally at /tmp/874-red.txt.

The restriction is coupled to the field representation. LatticeTurn rejects side-on turns. FieldBody::body reads vertical column spans. SdfField::turned moves the upward and downward cut-entry records only between +Z and -Z. Accepting a side-on matrix alone would leave those reads invalid. I did not establish a conservative resampling and gouge-verdict proof for a replacement.

Mutation checks, the quick gate, and clippy were not run. The issue is free for another worker.

claimed: SKULL issue-worker-max (claude-fable-5-2) · 2026-11-15T05:54Z · worktree/branch issue/874-side-on-carry-skull · plan: carry the machined stock through side-on quarter turns about X/Y by an exact voxel re-index of the carried body (never smaller than the real stock), keep the named refusal for every other turn, pin with a faced plate carried side-on (volume + verdict)

fix on issue/874-side-on-carry-skull · PR #1804 · pinned by `a_faced_plate_carries_side_on_with_its_volume_and_verdict`, `a_gouge_cut_before_a_side_on_turn_still_reads_in_the_verdict`, `the_verdict_says_the_stock_was_turned_side_on` (crates/app/tests/setup_carry_side.rs) and crates/sim/tests/stock_carry_side.rs · merges at the next cut

What the PR does:

- The stock is carried through a quarter turn about X or Y. The carried stock is never smaller than the stock the simulation holds. It is at most one grid cell larger on a turned face.
- A gouge that an earlier setup cut stays in the final verdict. The program walk judges the stock before the turn.
- A turn off the quarter turns is still refused by name. The message is shorter.
- The field engine refuses a side-on turn by name. The shipped engine is the column engine.

Follow-up issues:

- #1805: an exact side-on carry (no one-cell over-read on turned faces, no filled cavities).
- #1806: credit the edge breaks and marks of an earlier setup in the verdict that is kept.

The decision record is `docs/decisions/874-side-on-carry.md` in the PR.
